candidates.meaning: Show films of genres Sci-Fi and Fantasy that were filmed in New Zealand.
candidates.sql: SELECT title FROM Films WHERE genreId IN (SELECT id FROM Genres WHERE genreName IN ('Sci-Fi', 'Fantasy')) AND filmingLocation = 'New Zealand'

candidates.meaning: Retrieve titles of films that are either Sci-Fi or Fantasy genres and were filmed in New Zealand.

candidates.meaning: Retrieve titles of films that are either Sci-Fi or Fantasy genres and have at least one filming location as New Zealand.
candidates.sql: SELECT title FROM Films WHERE genreId IN (SELECT id FROM Genres WHERE genreName IN ('Sci-Fi', 'Fantasy')) AND 'New Zealand' IN (SELECT filmingLocation FROM Films)
